name: com.run402.agent-utils/evm-due-diligence
title: EVM Wallet & Token Due-Diligence (x402)
description: x402 pay-per-call EVM wallet & token due-diligence reports on 6 chains, tx decoder, prices

tools.name: chainlink_prices
tools.description: $0.002 (x402). Live USD prices: Chainlink feeds for majors (symbols=ETH,BTC) or any Base token by contract (token=0x...) from on-chain DEX pools.

tools.name: decode_evm_tx
tools.description: $0.03 (x402). Decode one EVM transaction: status, from/to, value, fee, block time, ERC-20 transfers.

tools.name: did_wallet_get_paid
tools.description: $0.03 (x402). Balances + every incoming USDC/USDT transfer in the last N hours on 6 EVM chains.

tools.name: domain_dns_whois
tools.description: $0.002 (x402). Domain intelligence in one call: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA via DNS-over-HTTPS), email auth (SPF, DMARC), and RDAP registration (registrar, created/expiry dates, age in days, status, nameservers, DNSSEC, unregistered detection). $0.002 per call.

domain.description: domain name, e.g. example.com (URL also accepted)

tools.name: evm_balance
tools.description: $0.002 (x402). Balance of one wallet on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BSC: native coin, or any ERC-20 (pass token=0x...), with symbol, decimals, formatted and raw amounts and block number. Live RPC with fallbacks.

tools.name: evm_block
tools.description: $0.002 (x402). Block header facts on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BSC: by number, latest, or by timestamp (unix or ISO; returns the last block at or before that time via binary search). Number, hash, time, tx count, gas used, base fee.

tools.name: evm_code
tools.description: $0.002 (x402). Is this address a contract, a plain EOA, or an EIP-7702 delegated EOA? On Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BSC: bytecode size, 7702 delegate target, upgradeable-proxy slots (EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon, legacy Zeppelin) and nonce.

tools.name: evm_nonce
tools.description: $0.001 (x402). Latest and pending transaction count for an address on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BSC, the next nonce to use, and how many of its txs are pending.

tools.name: free_sample_report
tools.description: Free. Sample output: sample=wallet-full (full wallet report for vitalik.eth), sample=token-full&chain=<chain> (USDC token report), or sample=wallet-report&chain=<chain>.

tools.name: name_resolve
tools.description: $0.003 (x402). Resolve an ENS name (incl. wildcard and CCIP-read off-chain resolvers) or a Basename (name.base.eth, Base registry) to an address, or an address to its verified ENS primary name. Returns found=false for unregistered names.

tools.name: token_due_diligence_report
tools.description: $0.25 (x402, USDC on Base). ERC-20 due diligence on ethereum|base|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bsc: metadata, supply, upgradeable-proxy detection, owner/renounced, paused, recent transfer activity, Chainlink price, risk flags.

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: $0.01 (x402). On-chain token verdict (SOLID/OK/CAUTION/RISKY/AVOID, 0-100 score, reasons) for Base/EVM tokens (incl. DEX liquidity, price) and Solana mints (mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 risks).

tools.name: wallet_due_diligence_report
tools.description: $0.25 (x402, USDC on Base). 6-chain EVM wallet due-diligence report: native + USDC/USDT balances, USD estimate (Chainlink), outgoing tx counts, contract vs EOA, EIP-7702 delegation, recent inflows, risk flags. Unpaid calls return the x402 payment requirements and pay_at URL.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: $0.003 (x402). Current weather, 24h hourly and ~9-day daily forecast for a city or lat/lon (MET Norway, CC BY 4.0).

tools.name: web_to_markdown
tools.description: $0.01 (x402). Fetch a public web page and return clean main-content Markdown plus links.
